q: What exactly is this kit, and what do I get when I clone it?
a: This kit is a production-ready fullstack React 19 and Next.js 15 App Router platform integrated with Supabase and shadcn/ui. You get a pre-wired Docker Compose container setup, 6 AI agent rule dialects, 5 operational skills, automated TypeScript checks, and a runnable Task management module.

q: Which versions does it pin, and why those?
a: It pins TypeScript 5.5+, Next.js 15, React 19, and Supabase / PostgreSQL 16. These versions deliver asynchronous Request APIs, Server Actions with automatic revalidation, and native PostgreSQL Row Level Security.

q: Which AI coding agents are supported, and how do the rules reach each one?
a: Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, GitHub Copilot, Cline, and Antigravity are supported via transpiled native dialect targets generated from canonical source rules.

q: What do I need installed before I start?
a: You only need Node.js 20+ (LTS) and npm 10+, or Docker Engine 24+ if running via Docker Compose.

q: How long does installation take, honestly, and what can slow it down?
a: A fresh install takes between 30 to 60 seconds on a standard broadband connection. Primary bottleneck is pulling npm dependencies.

q: Is the starter production-shaped or a demo? What must I change before real production?
a: The starter is production-shaped with strict security defaults. Before production release, link your real Supabase project credentials in .env.local, apply migrations, and verify RLS policies.

q: How is security handled in this kit, and where are its checks?
a: Security is enforced at multiple layers: database-level PostgreSQL Row Level Security, Zod Server Action input validation, HttpOnly SSR cookies, and automated secret scanning. The complete 12-control suite is in security/checks.json.

q: Can I change the design? Where do the design tokens live?
a: Yes. Design tokens are documented in DESIGN.md. You can customize Tailwind CSS classes and shadcn/ui component tokens directly in layout.tsx and components/.

q: How do I update when a new kit version releases?
a: Review CHANGELOG.md and merge updates to rules/ and skills/. Project-specific Server Actions, pages, and .env.local settings remain untouched.

q: Can I use it for commercial and client work?
a: Yes. The entire kit is licensed under the permissive MIT License with zero royalties.

q: How do I contribute a fix or a skill back?
a: Submit a PR to https://github.com/Umar-444/Techtalks-stack-kits adhering to the 18-checkpoint completeness standard.

q: Where do I get help or report a problem?
a: Open an issue on the repository or participate in community discussions at https://techtalks.itsumarfarooq.com.

q: How does Supabase Row Level Security protect user data?
a: PostgreSQL enforces RLS policies directly in the database engine using auth.uid() = user_id. Even if an attacker tampers with client-side query parameters, the database refuses to return or mutate cross-tenant records.

q: Why use Server Actions instead of API Route Handlers?
a: Server Actions eliminate client-side API boilerplate, provide seamless type safety from database to form, and automatically trigger cache revalidation via revalidatePath().
